name: jessee
description: A native Mac recorder that turns narrated walkthroughs and imported videos into visual, AI-ready documents.

scripts.mac:check: npm run mac:typecheck && npm run mac:editor && swift test && zsh mac/Support/build-app.sh
scripts.site:preview: npm run site:build && wrangler pages dev ./site-dist
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run site:build && wrangler pages deploy ./site-dist --project-name jessee --branch main
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:preview: npm run site:build && wrangler pages deploy ./site-dist --project-name jessee --branch preview
